reasoning: On the season so far the Cavaliers are the stronger team; with home court the Cavaliers start about 8 points better, in a game of about 234 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pacers.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Pacers (revenge).
Bottom line: the Cavaliers win 69 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 207 and 255 total points.
